witness.branch: Protected lane use on a one-way multilane road
witness.quote: Every motorcycle or moped when being driven on the highway is entitled to full use of the traffic lane it is occupying
witness.reason: The fixed one-way multilane road supports distinct ego and protected-motorcycle routes.
